title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — October 01, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B7.8 (Peaked October 01, 2026 at 12:55 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 302 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Things are buzzing a bit in near-Earth space! 🛰💡🌌

A broad coronal-hole-like dark region is the main visual feature today, while sunspot activity and the outer-corona view look relatively quiet.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
